## Overview

This [[adyen]] Touch'n Go for Android page, captured 2026-09-15 (page metadata last modified 2019-09-30), is a **navigation chooser** for adding the method to an Android app. It links separate Drop-in and Components child guides and Android Sessions-flow base guides. See [[adyen-online-payments]]. Its labels do not establish child-guide version, setup, redirect, account eligibility or payment-result behavior. See raw lines 15–29.

## Key takeaways

- The Drop-in link is labeled an all-in-one UI route; the Components link is labeled a prebuilt Component route for rendering Touch'n Go in an Android app. The actual method instructions reside in those child guides. See raw lines 19–27.
- The final sentence links Android Drop-in and Components **Sessions** base integration guides. This chooser does not say that Advanced flows are unavailable; nor does it provide a complete Sessions implementation. Follow the appropriate base and child guide before asserting prerequisites or outcomes. See raw line 29.
